findings.title: Script exits with status 0 on its failure paths
findings.description: `cleanup()` ends with `exit 0`, and the script calls `cleanup` on both failure paths: the rate-limit branch (around line 47) and the "Failed to extract Tunnelmole URL" branch (around line 61). A caller or CI job cannot tell that the tunnel setup failed.

findings.title: `sed -i ''` syntax works only on BSD/macOS sed
findings.description: The `sed -i '' -E ...` form is BSD syntax. GNU sed reads `''` as the script and fails on the following argument, so the script cannot update `GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL` on Linux. The script depends on `tmole`, `pgrep`, and `/tmp` as well, so the platform assumption should be documented or made portable.

findings.title: Migration header contradicts the SQL that follows it
findings.description: The generated header says the required column cannot be added "without a default value". The SQL then adds the column with `DEFAULT NOW()`. The comment is accurate for the generated statement but misleading next to the hand-edited statement.

findings.title: Imports and constructor used by new code are not visible in the diff
findings.description: `CalendarService.ts` now calls `SelectedCalendarRepository.updateManyByCredentialId`, and `connectedCalendars.handler.ts` calls `new CalendarCacheRepository()`. The diff does not show the `SelectedCalendarRepository` import in `CalendarService.ts`, and it does not show whether `CalendarCacheRepository` takes constructor arguments. Both need checking in the full files.
